Directorate of State Lotteries

The Directorate of State Lotteries is constituted under the Lotteries (Regulation) Act, 1998 and conducts weekly draws on behalf of the State Government. Results and updates for the State Government's weekly online lottery draws are published here every Wednesday and Saturday.

Tickets are sold only through authorised state agents and stockists. Prize winners should claim their prize within thirty days of the draw at the Directorate office.

Current Schemes

  • Weekly Bumper, drawn every Wednesday
  • Monthly Bumper, drawn on the last Saturday of the month
  • Festival Bumper, drawn during major festivals

Notices

  • Draw schedule for the next quarter has been published.
  • Ticket price revision notification effective from next month.
  • Unclaimed prize list for the previous quarter is available at the Directorate office.

Legal Notice

This lottery is conducted by the State Government under the Lotteries (Regulation) Act, 1998 and the Lotteries (Regulation) Rules, 2010. Sale of this lottery outside the authorised territory is prohibited. Only tickets purchased from authorised stockists are valid for prize claims.
